state: concept space claim — NOT FOR PRINTING
purpose: First enclosure study. The gamepad stays whole inside its original shell; this pod holds everything added to it (display, S3, DevKitC/WROOM, battery, charger, regulator, switch, microphone). Signal wiring is out of scope (Bluetooth is being explored); only the power parts and one power lead to the gamepad are provided for.
frame: Pod interior frame. Origin at the lower-left inside corner of the front wall as the user looks at the screen. X right, Y up, Z from the inside of the front wall toward the back of the pod. Millimetres.
